description: BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam. Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock. In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust. What will you do? You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back. You will: Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one. Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on. Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk. Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves. Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments. Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does. Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark. Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start. What we're looking for You'll need: 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role. At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders. A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter. A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike. Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture. Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar). Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services. Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana. Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure. Bonus points for: Experience with options or crypto markets. Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs). Low-latency or market-making environments. Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it. Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling. Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency. Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases. Pay, location, and relocation Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results. Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund. Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa. Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling. What else is in it for you Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day How we work We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from. This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from the first alert to the long-term fix and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development. Ready to keep a 24/7 trading firm running? Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days. Our culture At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals. In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees. Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems. Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools. Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants. Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort: 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family. 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family. 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow. 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office. 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota. 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks. 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events. 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success. description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam. Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows. What you'll do As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets Who you are Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions! You could be our next team mate if you: Have 4+ years of Product Management experience, including at least 1 year working on mobile applications, with a track record of shipping products that have delivered meaningful business results and proven user value Have experience developing SaaS or mobile products, ideally including a network effect component such as social networking, communication services, or collaborative workplace tools Approach problems with an analytical mindset, balancing quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions Communicate with clarity and conviction to align diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, driving vision and articulating user value and business impact Are highly organised and disciplined in project management, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to ask tough questions and say no when needed Now, it would be fantastic if you: Have experience with health tech, marketplace, or platform products Are familiar with operating in multi-market environments Have worked in a scale-up or fast-paced product organisation Our AI vision We believe in the responsible use of AI to improve healthcare. Find out more about our approach here . What we offer: Company pension scheme through our partner Allianz 27 days of annual leave per year (and the ability to accrue more days on your work anniversary!) Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care Free breakfast and lunch plan every day on-site Bike lease scheme with our partner Lease a Bike, 35% price below the market Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth Discounted membership with Urban Sports Club Continuous training programs on all key competencies (English, soft skills, expertise) Reimbursement of public transportation if you live outside the Amsterdam highway ring Parent Care Program: Various initiatives supporting parenthood, including 100% paid parental leave up to 16 weeks, including bonuses, for mothers and up to 5 weeks for the co-parent, flexible return and 3 days of leave per year for child sickness Relocation support for international mobilities The interview process Recruiter Interview Manager Interview Case Study Final Interview Criminal background check and a copy of your Certificate of Good Conduct ("Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag, VOG") (if required) Job details Permanent position Full-Time Amsterdam Start date: As soon as possible Compensation: fix + bonus on objectives (according to your profile) At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability. To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of! All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here . Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
